messages:
Sam (Finance): Quick sync 1: Product wants to roll a small A/B pricing experiment for mid-market next week. Need decisions on grandfathering length, mid-cycle billing, invoice annotations, and vendor constraints. Looping in @Nora and @Vince.

Evan (Product): Plan: control = current list, variant = +10% list but deeper stepdowns at 300k tokens. Cohort: 5% of mid-market for 21 days. We want experiment_id on the export rows only. No PDF changes.

Nora (Billing Ops): Ops constraints: we can add experiment_id to billing_export rows easily. Invoice PDF changes are heavy and vary by gateway. For mid-cycle cohort flips we can either prorate or bill final usage and reconcile. Ops prefers provisional prorate + month-end recon with automated credits under a threshold.

Priya (Sales): Sales requests that any account with a signed discount schedule be excluded by default and only included if AM opts in. Also prefer 90-day grandfathering for existing customers.

Vince (Legal): 90 days is acceptable. Need short customer wording and an opt-out flag. Suggest: "Existing agreements are honored for 90 days following assignment to the experiment; account teams may opt-in customers earlier."

Sam (Finance): Decision summary: 1) export experiment_id: yes 2) invoice PDF changes: no 3) grandfathering: 90 days, opt-in allowed 4) mid-cycle: provisional prorate + recon. Nora, can you draft runbook and thresholds?

Nora (Billing Ops): Will do. Proposed thresholds: >$50 corrected invoice (if gateway supports), $10-$50 credit memo, < $10 auto-credit. I'll confirm Chargebee/Stripe behavior and post runbook draft in /docs by EOD.

billing-bot: Scheduled job "midmarket-pricing-ab" for 2025-02-28T09:00:00Z (job id: mid-ab-2025-02-28).

Evan (Product): Acceptance criteria: revenue delta within +/-2% for cohort, <1% increase in billing tickets, exports include experiment_id for 100% of assigned accounts.

Priya (Sales): I'll send the exclusion list of negotiated deals today.

Sam (Finance): Thanks everyone. Gate rollout on runbook + staging export sample and a quick recon sanity check.
